glsa.title: Freenet: Deanonymization Vulnerability
glsa.synopsis: A vulnerability has been discovered in Freenet, where an XSS vulnerability could lead to deanonymization.

background.p: Freenet is an encrypted network without censorship.

description.p: A vulnerability has been discovered in Freenet. Please review the CVE identifier referenced below for details.

impact.p: This release fixes as an XSS vulnerability that may allow an attacker to deanonymize the user.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All Freenet users should upgrade to the latest version:
